description: Bij einde van een vaatwasser-sessie: sla duur/kwh op (20-slot logboek) en de curve (max 8 slots, fijn+grof gekoppeld). Duplicaten (±5 min, ±10%/0.05 kWh) worden overgeslagen tenzij vollediger. Bij volle opslag: bescherm-uitersten (kortste/langste blijft) + LRU voor de rest.

data.value: {% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_duren') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(',') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [duur_min | int | string] %}{{ lst[-20:] | join(',') }}

{% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_kwh') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(',') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [kwh_totaal | string] %}{{ lst[-20:] | join(',') }}

{% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_duren') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(',') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [duur_min | int | string] %}{{ lst[-8:] | join(',') }}

{% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_kwh') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(',') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [kwh_totaal | string] %}{{ lst[-8:] | join(',') }}

{% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(';') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve')] %}{{ lst[-8:] | join(';') }}

{% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves_grof') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(';') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve_grof')] %}{{ lst[-8:] | join(';') }}

{% set cur = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_last_used') %}{% set lst = (cur.split(',') if cur not in ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else []) %}{% set lst = lst + [((now().timestamp() | int) | string)] %}{{ lst[-8:] | join(',') }}

{% set lst = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_duren').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set idx = evict_index | int %}{% set new_lst = lst[:idx] + [duur_min | int | string] + lst[idx+1:] %}{{ new_lst | join(',') }}

{% set lst = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_kwh').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set idx = evict_index | int %}{% set new_lst = lst[:idx] + [kwh_totaal | string] + lst[idx+1:] %}{{ new_lst | join(',') }}

{% set lst = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves').split(';') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set idx = evict_index | int %}{% set new_lst = lst[:idx] + [states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve')] + lst[idx+1:] %}{{ new_lst | join(';') }}

{% set lst = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves_grof').split(';') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set idx = evict_index | int %}{% set new_lst = lst[:idx] + [states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve_grof')] + lst[idx+1:] %}{{ new_lst | join(';') }}

{% set lst = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_last_used').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set idx = match_index | int %}{% if idx < (lst|length) %}{% set new_lst = lst[:idx] + [((now().timestamp() | int) | string)] + lst[idx+1:] %}{% else %}{% set new_lst = lst + [((now().timestamp() | int) | string)] %}{% endif %}{{ new_lst | join(',') }}

{% set lst = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves').split(';') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set idx = match_index | int %}{% if idx < (lst|length) %}{% set new_lst = lst[:idx] + [states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve')] + lst[idx+1:] %}{% else %}{% set new_lst = lst + [states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve')] %}{% endif %}{{ new_lst[-8:] | join(';') }}

actions.note: Reset sessie-energie naar 0 nu duur/kwh/curve zijn opgeslagen. Voorkomt een platte staart in de verbruiksgrafiek tot de volgende sessie-start opnieuw calibreert. Laatste actie: alle opslag hierboven gebruikt de kwh_totaal variabele (1x berekend bij trigger), niet een live meting.

variables.duur_min: {{ ((now().timestamp() - state_attr('input_datetime.vaatwasser_sessie_start', 'timestamp')) / 60) | round(0) if state_attr('input_datetime.vaatwasser_sessie_start', 'timestamp') is not none else 0 }}
variables.match_index: {% set cd = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_duren').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | map('float') | list %}{% set ck = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_kwh').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | map('float') | list %}{% set n = [cd|length, ck|length] | min %}{% set ns = namespace(idx=-1) %}{% for i in range(n) %}{% set kdiff = (ck[i] - kwh_totaal) | abs %}{% if (cd[i] - duur_min) | abs <= 5 and ck[i] > 0 and (kdiff <= 0.05 or (kdiff / ck[i]) <= 0.10) %}{% set ns.idx = i %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.idx }}
variables.existing_completeness: {% set idx = match_index | int %}{% if idx == -1 %}0{% else %}{% set cd = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_duren').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | map('float') | list %}{% set existing_dur = cd[idx] %}{% set cf = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves').split(';') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set cg = states('input_text.vaatwasser_sessie_curves_grof').split(';') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list %}{% set fine_pts = (cf[idx].split('|') | reject('eq','') | list | length) if idx < (cf|length) else 0 %}{% set grof_pts = (cg[idx].split('|') | reject('eq','') | list | length) if idx < (cg|length) else 0 %}{% set fine_expected = [ (existing_dur // 10) | int, 6 ] | min %}{% set grof_expected = [ (existing_dur // 20) | int, 9 ] | min %}{% set total_expected = [fine_expected + grof_expected, 1] | max %}{{ ((fine_pts + grof_pts) / total_expected) | round(3) }}{% endif %}
variables.new_completeness: {% set fine_pts = states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve').split('|') | reject('eq','') | list | length %}{% set grof_pts = states('input_text.vaatwasser_huidige_curve_grof').split('|') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | list | length %}{% set fine_expected = [ (duur_min // 10) | int, 6 ] | min %}{% set grof_expected = [ (duur_min // 20) | int, 9 ] | min %}{% set total_expected = [fine_expected + grof_expected, 1] | max %}{{ ((fine_pts + grof_pts) / total_expected) | round(3) }}
variables.evict_index: {% set cd = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_duren').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | map('float') | list %}{% if cd | length < 8 %}-1{% else %}{% set cl_raw = states('input_text.vaatwasser_curve_last_used').split(',') | reject('in', ['', 'unknown','unavailable']) | map('float') | list %}{% set min_val = cd | min %}{% set max_val = cd | max %}{% set min_idx = cd.index(min_val) %}{% set max_idx = cd.index(max_val) %}{% set ns = namespace(evict=-1, oldest=none) %}{% for i in range(cd | length) %}{% if i != min_idx and i != max_idx %}{% set lu = cl_raw[i] if i < cl_raw | length else 0 %}{% if ns.oldest is none or lu < ns.oldest %}{% set ns.oldest = lu %}{% set ns.evict = i %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.evict }}{% endif %}
